왜.x: Why didn't you come to school yesterday?
왜.e: Sounds like English 'way', but means 'why': 왜요? 'Why?'
왜.t: Politely ask 왜요? A bare 왜? can sound blunt to elders.

바나나.x: How much is a bunch of bananas?
바나나.e: From English 'banana' — three even syllables: ba-na-na.

표.e: 기차표 = train ticket; 비행기표 = plane ticket.
표.t: Count tickets with 장: 표 한 장, 표 두 장.

입학.x: In Korea, students usually start school in March.

튀기다.x: Potatoes taste better when you deep-fry them in oil.
튀기다.e: Root of 튀김 'fried food'; 감자튀김 are French fries.

누군가.x: Someone is knocking on the door outside.
누군가.e: From 누구 'who' + -ㄴ가 'is it?' — a question turned into 'someone'.

상징.x: The Taegeukgi is an important symbol that represents South Korea.

낮아지다.m: to become lower, to drop, to fall
낮아지다.x: As night fell, the temperature dropped a lot.

상상하다.x: I tried imagining what I'll be like in ten years.

습득하다.m: to acquire, to learn (a skill or knowledge)
습득하다.x: Children acquire languages faster than adults.
습득하다.t: A homonym 습득 means 'picking up a lost item', as in 습득물 'found property'.

협력.ex: 두 회사는 협력을 통해 새 제품을 만들었습니다.
협력.x: The two companies created a new product through collaboration.

객관적.ex: 자기 자신을 객관적으로 보는 것은 어려워요.
객관적.x: It's hard to see yourself objectively.
객관적.e: Literally 'a guest's view' — seeing from outside.

메신저.x: I'll send you the meeting materials by messenger.
메신저.t: At work 메신저 often means the company's internal chat tool, used for quick questions instead of email.

공급.x: The power supply was temporarily cut off.

가짜 뉴스.x: You need to watch out for fake news on the internet.
가짜 뉴스.e: Native 가짜 'fake' + 뉴스 from English 'news'; the opposite of 가짜 is 진짜 'real'.

성명.ex: 시민 단체가 정부를 비판하는 성명을 발표했어요.
성명.x: A civic group released a statement criticizing the government.
성명.e: Literally 'clearly voiced'; a homonym 성명 means 'full name'.
성명.t: Common phrase: 성명을 발표하다 'to issue a statement'.

쑤시다.m: to ache, to throb; to poke, to pick
쑤시다.x: My knees ache when it rains.
쑤시다.e: Its basic sense is 'to poke or jab' — the ache feels like being jabbed.
쑤시다.t: A classic complaint: 온몸이 쑤셔요 'My whole body aches', often with flu or before rain.
rel: to have a stiff, sharp ache

중력.x: The moon's gravity is much weaker than Earth's.
중력.t: Pronounced [중녁]: ㄹ becomes ㄴ after ㅇ.

분리 배출.m: sorting trash for disposal, separate collection
분리 배출.ex: 한국에서는 쓰레기를 꼭 분리 배출해야 해요.
분리 배출.x: In Korea, you must sort your trash before putting it out.
분리 배출.e: Literally 'separate and put out'; Korea's strict trash-sorting system.
분리 배출.t: Pronounced [불리 배출]: ㄴ becomes ㄹ before ㄹ.

놀라움.ex: 그 소식은 많은 사람들에게 놀라움을 주었어요.
놀라움.x: That news came as a surprise to many people.

이해심.ex: 우리 부모님은 이해심이 많으셔서 대화가 잘 통해요.
이해심.x: My parents are very understanding, so we communicate well.

싹싹하다.ex: 새로 온 직원이 싹싹해서 모두 좋아해요.
싹싹하다.x: The new employee is so friendly and polite that everyone likes her.
싹싹하다.t: Praises someone, often younger, who greets people cheerfully and is quick to help; pronounced [싹싸카다].

당당하다.x: In an interview, state your thoughts confidently.
당당하다.e: Literally 'hall-hall' — grand and imposing like a great hall.

총명하다.x: That child was bright from a young age.
총명하다.e: Literally 'keen ears and bright eyes' — sharp senses, sharp mind.

구태여.forms: 구태여 + question or negative (구태여 ~할 필요 없다)
구태여.m: deliberately, go out of one's way to, bother to
구태여.x: There's no need to bother going all the way there.
구태여.e: A more formal, written cousin of 굳이.

그다지.x: It's not all that cold today.
그다지.t: Used only with negatives, like 별로 but a bit more written in tone.

도리어.forms: 도리어 + opposite result; spoken ≈ 오히려, 되레
도리어.x: I tried to help but ended up ruining things instead.

머지않아.m: soon, before long, in the near future
머지않아.x: There will be good news before long.
머지않아.e: 멀지 않아 'not being far' with ㄹ dropped: 'not far off'.
머지않아.t: Written as one word for time ('soon'); 멀지 않아 is used for physical distance.

어쩌다.forms: 어쩌다(가) + verb: 어쩌다 만나다; 어쩌다 이렇게 됐어요?
어쩌다.m: by chance, accidentally; occasionally; how on earth
어쩌다.x: I ran into an old friend on the street by chance.

더듬다.m: to grope, to feel for; to stammer; to search (one's memory)
더듬다.x: It was dark, so I felt along the wall for the switch.
더듬다.t: 말을 더듬다 means to stutter; 기억을 더듬다 means to search one's memory.

되돌아가다.x: I left my wallet behind, so I went back home.
되돌아가다.e: 되- 'back' + 돌아가다 'to go back': stresses turning back the way you came.

뒤떨어지다.m: to fall behind, to lag behind; to be outdated
뒤떨어지다.x: This phone's design is a bit outdated.
뒤떨어지다.e: 뒤 'behind' + 떨어지다 'to drop away': dropping behind others.
뒤떨어지다.t: 시대에 뒤떨어지다 'to be behind the times' is a common phrase.

튀어나오다.m: to jump out, pop out; to stick out
튀어나오다.ex: 골목에서 고양이 한 마리가 갑자기 튀어나왔어요.
튀어나오다.x: A cat suddenly jumped out of the alley.
튀어나오다.e: 튀다 'to bounce, spring' + 나오다 'to come out'.

급격하다.e: Literally 'urgent and violent' — change that comes fast and hard.

눈앞이 캄캄하다.m: to feel hopeless, to be at a loss, to not know what to do
눈앞이 캄캄하다.ex: 지갑과 여권을 모두 잃어버려서 눈앞이 캄캄했어요.
눈앞이 캄캄하다.x: I lost both my wallet and my passport, and I had no idea what to do.
눈앞이 캄캄하다.e: Literally 'everything in front of my eyes goes pitch-black.'
눈앞이 캄캄하다.t: Pronounced [누나피 캄캄하다]: the ㅍ of 앞 links over to the next vowel.

뜨개질.x: In winter, I knit scarves myself.

열람실.m: reading room, study room (in a library)
열람실.ex: 시험 기간이라서 도서관 열람실에 자리가 없어요.
열람실.x: It's exam period, so there are no seats in the library reading room.
열람실.t: In Korean libraries it is mainly where students study with their own books; seats are often booked at a kiosk, and silence is strictly kept.

황금만능주의.m: the belief that money is all-powerful, mammonism, materialism
황금만능주의.ex: 황금만능주의가 사회를 병들게 한다는 지적이 많습니다.
황금만능주의.x: Many point out that the belief that money is everything is making society sick.

청렴결백하다.x: That mayor was respected as an honest, incorruptible person.
청렴결백하다.e: Literally 'clear and honest, clean and white.'
청렴결백하다.t: Pronounced [청념결배카다] — nasalization; used mostly about public officials.

윗물이 맑아야 아랫물이 맑다.forms: 윗물이 맑아야 아랫물이 맑다고 · 윗물이 맑아야 아랫물이 맑은 법이다
윗물이 맑아야 아랫물이 맑다.m: leaders must set a good example for those below them
윗물이 맑아야 아랫물이 맑다.ex: 윗물이 맑아야 아랫물이 맑다고, 사장님부터 규칙을 지켜야 해요.
윗물이 맑아야 아랫물이 맑다.x: Clean water upstream makes clean water downstream—the boss should follow the rules first.
윗물이 맑아야 아랫물이 맑다.e: Water upstream must be clear for the water downstream to be clear.
윗물이 맑아야 아랫물이 맑다.t: Pronounced [윈무리 말가야 아랜무리 막따] — nasalization and consonant simplification.

수필가.x: That essayist's writing is easy to read and warm.
수필가.e: 수필 'essay' is literally 'following the brush', writing freely as thoughts come.

한.m: han, deep-seated grief, unresolved sorrow and resentment; lifelong regret
한.ex: 할머니는 평생 고향에 못 간 한을 품고 사셨어요.
한.x: Grandma lived her whole life with the deep sorrow of never returning to her hometown.
한.e: A core Korean emotion: long-held sorrow and longing mixed with resentment.

내부자거래.ex: 그 임원은 내부자거래 혐의로 조사를 받았습니다.
내부자거래.x: The executive was investigated on suspicion of insider trading.
내부자거래.e: Literally 'insider dealing'; -자 = person who does or is it: 내부자 'insider.'

계획경제.x: The former Soviet Union ran a planned economy.

만년설.ex: 히말라야의 만년설이 빠른 속도로 녹고 있습니다.
만년설.x: The permanent snow of the Himalayas is melting fast.

상보성.ex: 두 이론은 서로 상보성을 지니고 있습니다.
상보성.x: The two theories complement each other.

주안점.ex: 이번 개혁의 주안점은 교육의 질을 높이는 거예요.
주안점.x: The main focus of this reform is raising the quality of education.
주안점.e: Literally 'the point where the main eye rests'.
주안점.t: Common pattern: N에 주안점을 두다, 'to focus on N.'

양두구육.m: false advertising, a fine front hiding something worse
양두구육.ex: 광고와 실제 제품이 너무 달라서 양두구육이라는 비판을 받았어요.
양두구육.x: The product was so unlike its ad that it was criticized as false advertising.
양두구육.e: Literally 'hang a sheep's head, sell dog meat'.
